We process account registration data, wallet balances, transaction records, verification documents where required, and technical security logs. \n
\n
\n
\n

These Terms govern your use of this independent lottery information and wagering platform. We are not the Government Lottery Office (GLO), not an official agent, and not a government portal. GLO product rules are referenced only for prize-rule compatibility.

2. Products and prize rules

\n
\n
\n
\n

GLO-compatible L6: ticket price 80.00 THB; full-sale allocation 48,000,000.00 THB across 1,000,000 units; 14,168 prizes in the full-sale schedule; prizes scale proportionally when sales are below full sale.

\n

GLO-compatible N3: ticket price 20.00 THB; prize pool is 60% of N3 gross sales; payouts are variable and draw-calculated — never fixed historical amounts.

\n

Operator markets (3D, TOD, 2D, Run) are platform products. They are never described as GLO N3 or as government lottery products.

3. Prize duty and tax treatment

\n
\n
\n
\n

Stamp duty: 1.00 THB for every 200 THB of gross prize or fraction thereof (ceil(gross/200) × 1.00 THB). Prize income under this rule is treated as stamp-duty only; income tax is exempt on the displayed calculation. No 0.5% or 1% withholding model is used on this platform.

\n
\n
\n

\n

\n
\n
\n
\n

\n

Purchase: eligibility to purchase or wager may be checked against product rules, responsible-gaming settings, and account status before an order is accepted.

\n

Claim: prize claimants must be 20 years of age or older, calculated from the verified date of birth on file — never from a client-supplied age.

\n
\n
